name: plasma
description: Render custom HTML/CSS/JS interfaces on your desktop. Event-sourced organisms with live mutations, screenshots, and JS queries.
long_description:
PLASMA gives Claude the ability to generate and control fully custom HTML/CSS/JS interfaces rendered in a native macOS window (Plasma Surface).

Features:
- Create persistent UI organisms with event sourcing
- Incremental mutations without page reloads
- Query runtime state from the UI
- Screenshot the rendered surface
- Load external libraries (Three.js, D3, Chart.js)
- Full activity system for user interactions

tools.name: plasma_create
tools.description: Create a new PLASMA organism (UI application) with HTML/CSS/JS and interactive activities

tools.name: plasma_mutate
tools.description: Apply an incremental JavaScript mutation to an existing organism

tools.name: plasma_load
tools.description: Load a saved organism and render it on the Plasma Surface

tools.name: plasma_list
tools.description: List all saved organisms with metadata

tools.name: plasma_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a PNG screenshot of the Plasma Surface

tools.name: dynamic_ui_update
tools.description: Send incremental JS update without reloading

tools.name: dynamic_ui_query
tools.description: Execute JS in the surface and return the result

tools.name: wait_for_ui_event
tools.description: Block until user interacts with the UI, then return the event data (activityId, type, provided data)

surface_url.title: Plasma Surface URL
surface_url.description: WebSocket URL of the Plasma Surface app (default: ws://localhost:9420)
